summary: Iteration 16 — Translation Mode + Whisper Mode. Backend: 8/8 functional tests pass (languages list, incoming AR→EN with tip/reply, outgoing EN→AR Arabic-only, empty/long-text validation, TTS regression, live-assist regression). 2 tests skipped (free-tier 402 path not reachable because fresh signups land in trial_pro which has live_assist; persistence skip because /api/admin/stats does not expose a conversation count). Frontend (mobile 390x844, admin login): Courtroom Trainer modal now shows 3 gold-pill tabs (practice/live/translate). Translate tab consent gate works: checkbox unchecked + button disabled label 'Tick the box to continue' → after tick, button enables to 'Accept & continue'. Recorder UI (trans-their-lang, trans-my-lang, trans-context, trans-start) only renders AFTER clicking accept. Defaults ar/en. Each dropdown has 53 options. Mic-denied headless start does NOT crash and dropdowns stay enabled (tActive=false correctly preserved). WhisperButton + court-override testids confirmed via code review. /terms.html v1.1 served with 4a/4b/4c sections + 'Cross-border data flow' + footer 'v1.1'.

minor.issue: Does not expose a conversation total — testing agent could not verify db.conversations persistence purely through HTTP. Suggest adding 'conversations' (int) field to admin/stats OR an /api/admin/conversations/count endpoint for regression checks.

Free-tier 402 path is currently un-testable from the public API because /api/auth/signup auto-grants trial_pro (which has live_assist). Consider an admin-only fixture or env-flag to provision a true 'free' user, or assert gating via unit test.

issues: The 'Try Lex Free — 1 Free Question, No Signup' teaser overlay appears centered over the login form on first load and partially obscures the email/password inputs; an unsuspecting user can be confused into thinking signup is mandatory. Consider showing it as a bottom sheet that does not overlap the auth form OR dismiss it automatically when the email input gains focus.

action_items: (Optional) Expose conversation count via /api/admin/stats so future regressions can assert persistence directly.
(Optional) Provide a way for tests to spawn a true 'free' tier user so the /lex/translate 402 gate is regression-covered.
(Optional UX) Auto-dismiss the 'Try Lex Free' teaser when the login form receives focus — currently overlaps the email input on first paint.
critical_code_review_comments: TranslateRequest model in server.py does not constrain text length via Pydantic Field(max_length=2000); validation happens manually inside the handler. Works fine, but adding the constraint at the Pydantic layer would yield clearer 422 errors and free us from the hand-rolled check.

/api/lex/translate parses Claude's free-text 'TRANSLATION:/TIP:/REPLY:' contract by string-prefix matching. If Claude omits the REPLY: line (which it sometimes does for short statements), suggested_reply silently becomes empty. Consider a fallback that re-prompts when REPLY is missing for the 'incoming' direction.

Conversation log document for /lex/translate stores the entire raw Claude response in assistant_response (including the prompt scaffolding 'TRANSLATION:/TIP:/REPLY:' lines). For analytics/UX consumption you'd probably want the parsed object stored instead.

frontend/src/App.js is now 7,380 lines — well past the 700-line threshold from the code-review rubric. CourtroomModal alone spans ~600 lines and embeds Practice/Live/Translate panels inline. Strongly recommend splitting into separate component files (CourtroomPractice, CourtroomLive, CourtroomTranslate, WhisperButton, TransReplyBar).
